label: Upper Limbs
alt: Interactive anterior view of the left and right upper-limb skeletons, including the pectoral girdles and hand bones
annotationScope: Right shoulder, elbow, wrist, and hand: major bone landmarks plus selected muscle origins and insertions

hotspots.label: Acromion (right)
hotspots.description: Lateral projection of the scapular spine that forms the highest point of the shoulder.

hotspots.label: Coracoid process (right)
hotspots.description: Hook-like anterior projection of the scapula.

hotspots.label: Glenoid cavity (right)
hotspots.description: Shallow lateral socket that articulates with the head of the humerus.

hotspots.label: Inferior angle of scapula (right)
hotspots.description: Lowest point of the scapula where its medial and lateral borders meet.

hotspots.label: Greater tubercle of humerus (right)
hotspots.description: Large lateral prominence on the proximal humerus.

hotspots.label: Lesser tubercle of humerus (right)
hotspots.description: Anterior prominence of the proximal humerus medial to the intertubercular sulcus.

hotspots.label: Spine of scapula (right)
hotspots.description: Prominent posterior ridge that divides the supraspinous and infraspinous fossae.

hotspots.label: Supraspinous fossa (right)
hotspots.description: Depression superior to the spine of the scapula.

hotspots.label: Infraspinous fossa (right)
hotspots.description: Broad depression inferior to the spine of the scapula.

hotspots.label: Subscapular fossa
hotspots.description: Broad origin across the anterior surface of the scapula.

hotspots.label: Supraspinous fossa
hotspots.description: Origin in the supraspinous fossa, superior to the scapular spine.

hotspots.label: Infraspinous fossa
hotspots.description: Origin across the infraspinous fossa, inferior to the scapular spine.

hotspots.label: Lateral border of scapula
hotspots.description: Origin along the upper portion of the lateral border on the posterior scapula.

hotspots.label: Acromion — acromial part
hotspots.description: The acromial fibers arise here; the deltoid also originates from the lateral clavicle and scapular spine.

hotspots.label: Superior facet of greater tubercle
hotspots.description: Insertion on the superior facet of the greater tubercle of the humerus.

hotspots.label: Middle facet of greater tubercle
hotspots.description: Insertion on the middle facet of the greater tubercle of the humerus.

hotspots.label: Inferior facet of greater tubercle
hotspots.description: Insertion on the inferior facet of the greater tubercle of the humerus.

hotspots.label: Lesser tubercle
hotspots.description: Insertion on the lesser tubercle of the humerus.

hotspots.label: Deltoid tuberosity
hotspots.description: Insertion on the lateral surface of the humeral shaft.

hotspots.label: Lateral epicondyle of humerus (right)
hotspots.description: Lateral projection of the distal humerus that anchors the common extensor tendon.

hotspots.label: Medial epicondyle of humerus (right)
hotspots.description: Prominent medial projection of the distal humerus that anchors the common flexor tendon.

hotspots.label: Capitulum of humerus (right)
hotspots.description: Rounded lateral articular surface of the distal humerus that articulates with the head of the radius.

hotspots.label: Trochlea of humerus (right)
hotspots.description: Pulley-shaped medial articular surface of the distal humerus that articulates with the ulna.

hotspots.label: Olecranon (right)
hotspots.description: Large proximal projection of the ulna that forms the point of the elbow.

hotspots.label: Coronoid process of ulna (right)
hotspots.description: Anterior projection of the proximal ulna that enters the coronoid fossa during flexion.

hotspots.label: Head of radius (right)
hotspots.description: Disc-shaped proximal end of the radius that articulates with the capitulum and radial notch.

hotspots.label: Radial tuberosity (right)
hotspots.description: Roughened proximal radial prominence that receives the biceps brachii tendon.

hotspots.label: Lateral supracondylar ridge
hotspots.description: Origin along the proximal two-thirds of the lateral supracondylar ridge of the humerus.

hotspots.label: Radial tuberosity
hotspots.description: Insertion on the radial tuberosity; the bicipital aponeurosis also blends with forearm fascia.

hotspots.label: Coronoid process and ulnar tuberosity
hotspots.description: Insertion across the coronoid process and ulnar tuberosity of the proximal ulna.

hotspots.label: Olecranon
hotspots.description: Common triceps tendon insertion on the proximal olecranon of the ulna.

hotspots.label: Styloid process of ulna (right)
hotspots.description: Pointed distal ulnar projection on the medial side of the wrist.

hotspots.label: Styloid process of radius (right)
hotspots.description: Lateral distal projection of the radius on the thumb side of the wrist.

hotspots.label: Dorsal tubercle of radius (right)
hotspots.description: Posterior radial prominence that redirects the extensor pollicis longus tendon.

hotspots.label: Capitate (right)
hotspots.description: Largest and most central carpal bone in the distal row.

hotspots.label: Pisiform (right)
hotspots.description: Palpable sesamoid carpal on the palmar, ulnar side of the wrist.

hotspots.label: Hook of hamate (right)
hotspots.description: Palmar projection of the hamate that forms the ulnar boundary of Guyon canal.

hotspots.label: Tubercle of scaphoid (right)
hotspots.description: Palmar scaphoid projection that contributes to the lateral boundary of the carpal tunnel.

hotspots.label: Tubercle of trapezium (right)
hotspots.description: Palmar trapezial projection that contributes to the lateral boundary of the carpal tunnel.

hotspots.label: Lateral distal radius near the styloid process
hotspots.description: Insertion on the lateral distal radius at the base of the radial styloid process.

hotspots.label: Base of second metacarpal
hotspots.description: Primary insertion on the palmar base of the second metacarpal.

hotspots.label: Pisiform
hotspots.description: Insertion on the pisiform, with ligamentous continuations to the hook of hamate and base of the fifth metacarpal.

hotspots.label: Dorsal base of fifth metacarpal
hotspots.description: Insertion on the dorsal base of the fifth metacarpal.
